conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The final showdown is locked behind Saturn Proxima; check the Railjack requirements before investing in a Lich.

groups.activity: rank Solaris United to Old Mate, then clear Phase 3
groups.meta: start this the same day as the Lich hunt

rows.label: Solaris United rank Old Mate
rows.note: the maximum rank; required to access Profit-Taker

rows.label: Orokin Catalyst
rows.note: install on the Grattler first; a Gravimag will not fit without it

rows.label: Gravimag
rows.alt: or Tenno Lab dojo research (35,000 cr), or 20 p Market purchase

rows.label: Archgun Deployer
rows.note: Profit-Taker Phase 3 inbox reward; no other source

conditions: Without the Archgun Deployer, the Kuva Grattler cannot be equipped on the ground at all -- only in Archwing or on a Necramech.
A Gravimag refuses to install until the weapon already carries an Orokin Catalyst.
bonuses: This standing grind runs in parallel with the Lich hunt below; there is no reason to wait on one before starting the other.

disclosures.title: it burns its own cooldown fast
disclosures.body: The Kuva Grattler drains 4.38 seconds of Archgun Deployer cooldown per second of fire, versus the base Grattler's 8.93, so about 68 seconds of continuous fire empties it into the full 5-minute cooldown. A Sahasa Kubrow's Dig, Protea's Dispensary, or Lavos's universal-ammo ability are the named workarounds.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: charged Requiem mods
rows.alt: trade duplicates or buy cheap mods from players

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional but very strong

conditions: Requiem Eterna Relics contain the eight Requiem mods at equal odds and cannot be refined with Void Traces.
Each successful Lich vanquish consumes one charge from every equipped Requiem mod. Defiled mods have no charges left.
Palladino also sells retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, capped at 10 per week.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and has three charges. Two Oulls cannot be equipped in the same sequence.

disclosures.title: do this before spawning the Lich
disclosures.body: A new Lich is not removable until its three-Requiem sequence is solved. Stock a usable mod pool first; this avoids being stuck with a taxing adversary while farming your first set.

groups.activity: Capture; spawn and inspect Kuva Larvlings
groups.meta: up to 21 completed runs to force it

rows.label: Kuva Grattler Larvling
rows.note: weapon preview must say Kuva Grattler
rows.alt: buy a converted Kuva Grattler Lich from another player

rows.label: Heat progenitor
rows.note: use Ember, Wisp, Protea, Kullervo, or another Heat frame
rows.alt: Toxin is the common second pick; several people argue against Magnetic, since the Magnetic Archgun mod is strong enough you want that slot free anyway

conditions: After the yellow flicker, kill 15 enemies within about 30 seconds to spawn the Larvling. The downed Larvling previews its weapon before you Mercy it.
If the preview is not Grattler, leave it un-mercied and complete the mission. That weapon leaves the rotation until all other Kuva weapons have appeared; aborting does not advance the rotation.
The Warframe that performs the Mercy fixes the weapon's progenitor element.
bonuses: Every player receives 100 Kuva when a Larvling goes down, whether it is Mercied or refused.
Elemental Vice (Eleanor, Hollvania) lets you change the bonus element later at rank 40 with 5 Forma, so a rushed pick on the spawn run is not permanent.

disclosures.title: the only reliable weapon reroll
disclosures.body: Do not abort unwanted Larvlings. Finishing the Cassini Capture without using Mercy is what removes that shown weapon from the candidate pool and eventually guarantees the Grattler; an abort leaves it eligible.

groups.activity: kill Thralls, reveal mods, and test the sequence

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal mods, not their order

conditions: Thralls on your Lich's influence nodes build both Murmur progress and rage; joining another Lich's node grants Murmur but does not raise your own rage.
Murmur reveals arrive around 36, 60, and 84 progress, but the final three-mod order must be learned by Parazon attempts.

A failed Parazon attempt ranks up the Lich and moves it onward, but gives the squad a large Murmur bonus. Do not stab the very first spawn before a mod is revealed; afterward, stab to learn the order.
Let a spawned Lich convert nearby enemies before finishing it only in safe, solo-friendly missions. An un-stabbed Lich blocks other players' adversaries in public squads.
bonuses: Public squads accelerate Murmurs because failed attempts by any player benefit everyone.
Save downed Thrall Mercies until after a failed Lich stab: the rank-up resets rage, and those saved kills immediately begin rebuilding it.

disclosures.title: use Oull to cap the guessing
disclosures.body: Once one mod is known, use Oull to test positions efficiently. Oull -> mod 1 -> random, then Oull -> mod 2 -> mod 1, then mod 1 -> Oull -> mod 2, then mod 2 -> Oull -> mod 1 guarantees the kill by Lich level 4 in the worst case.

disclosures.title: make the spawn loop fit the goal
disclosures.body: Start on a long Earth mission such as Survival, Defense, Excavation, or Interception for plentiful Thralls. Later, when you only need rage, speed through Capture, Rescue, Sabotage, or Exterminate. A Requiem Ultimatum can force a confrontation once per week from Palladino for 10 Riven Slivers.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion gives a tradeable Lich contract instead of the weapon.
The weapon ignores its normal Mastery Rank restriction when claimed from a Lich, but still needs its own weapon slot.
A vanquish has a 25% chance to award Oull and a separate 25% chance to award a Requiem Ultimatum.
bonuses: The Grattler arrives built; no crafting materials or Foundry timer are needed. It still needs the Archgun Deployer above before it can be fired outside Archwing or a Necramech.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 x the higher bonus, 60%), rounded down to one decimal. Any result of at least 58% becomes 60%.
Do not fuse mediocre copies early. Keep several and fuse every donor into the highest roll; a 53% displayed bonus guarantees 60% on the next fusion.
Start the fusion from the Grattler you want to keep. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, Focus lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
bonuses: Only one copy needs the desired progenitor element because Valence Fusion lets you select the surviving element.

disclosures.title: a 60% chase is several full Liches
disclosures.body: A typical 25-60% roll averages around 42%, so reaching 60% commonly means two to four additional complete Lich cycles. Treat it as an optional long-term goal rather than part of getting a usable Grattler.
